title: Server State in Vue Apps
objectives: Implement a small typed useApi composable
Handle loading, error and stale states as architecture

examples.name: useApi.ts

exercise.prompt: A mutations succeeds; the cached list is now stale. Which invalidation trigger fits "comments after posting one"? Render the strategy.
hints: Mutations that affect a cached collection invalidate that cache key.
Polling is a last resort — it costs requests and still lags.

options: scattered ad hoc in each component
in the data layer (composable/store) so UI stays declarative
questions.explanation: Centralizing async states makes every screen consistent and testable.

questions.prompt: The cheapest correct invalidation for "updated my profile" is…
questions.explanation: Targeted key invalidation refreshes exactly the affected data.
